department: Department of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering, FAMU-FSU College of Engineering

deadline.value: Fall priority deadline for assistantships and financial aid is January 15, 2027 (late applications after January 15 are still reviewed for assistantships, though no applications are accepted after the May 1 final Fall deadline; Spring: November 1, Summer: March 1).
deadline.quote: Fall | 1 May | Note: Students seeking assistantships and other financial aid should apply for Fall semester admissions no later than 15th of January.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Mechanical Engineering; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants submit a Department Application - Graduate Faculty Preference Form, but the department admissions page and MAE graduate handbook do not state whether prior faculty advisor agreement is required for admission.

funding.value: FAMU-FSU Engineering PhD programs offer competitive funding packages (RAs, TAs, tuition waivers, health care coverage, and/or stipends); MAE notes all applicants are reviewed for assistantships with no separate funding application.
funding.quote: The FAMU-FSU College of Engineering Ph.D. programs offer competitive funding packages for newly admitted students.

entry_route.value: The MAE department offers both a standard PhD track for applicants who already hold a Master's degree and a direct BS-to-PhD track for applicants holding only a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: while the Doctoral programs offer a standard track for students who already have a Master's degree and a direct BS to PhD track for students who only have a bachelor's degree.

fee_waiver.value: Starting Fall 2027, the FAMU-FSU College of Engineering ADRGS office offers a limited number of application fee waivers exclusively for PhD applicants on a first-come, first-served basis (for FAMU applicants, complete the ApplyWeb application up to the Acknowledgement section without paying and submit the waiver request form).
fee_waiver.quote: offering a limited number of application fee waivers for PhD applicants, starting in the Fall 2027 semester. Only PhD applicants are eligible to request an application fee waiver at this time. Application fee waivers will be awarded on a first come, first serve basis.

also.quote: Starting for the Fall 2027 semester PhD applicants can apply for the application fee to be waived.

toefl_min.value: Department admissions pages state a minimum new iBT TOEFL score of 4.0 (550 paper-based); note the central College of Engineering admissions page still lists legacy 80 iBT.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the FAMU-FSU College of Engineering exempt-country list, and departments require English proficiency scores unless the applicant's country's official language is English or they graduated from an accredited U.S. bachelor's or master's program.
english_waiver.quote: The English Language Proficiency requirement can be waived, at the University-level, for applicants who have earned a minimum of a bachelor’s degree or higher in the US or in an English-Speaking Country.

also.quote: For International students, an English Proficiency Score Report is required if: | The applicant’s country’s official language is NOT English or | The applicant did NOT graduate from an accredited US institution with either a bachelor’s or master’s degree.

gre_general.value: GRE General is required (department cites minimum scores of 150 verbal and 155 quantitative), though qualified PhD applicants may apply for a GRE waiver using the College's GRE Waiver Form.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination General Test (GRE) score of a minimum GRE percentile of at least a 150 on the verbal portion and 155 on the quantitative portion of the test. GRE Waiver Form | FAMU-FSU

also.quote: highly qualified doctoral applicants may be eligible to waive the GRE.

notes: Covers Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering. Note: MAE's separate Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering is NOT authorized to enroll F-1 international students ('FAMU or FSU is not yet authorized to enroll F-1 international students in either the Masters or Doctoral degree program in Aerospace Engineering.').
